name: detective
description: Detective uses machine learning and purpose-built visualizations to help you to analyze and investigate security issues across your Amazon Web Services (Amazon Web Services) workloads.

subcommands.name: accept-invitation
subcommands.description: Accepts an invitation for the member account to contribute data to a behavior graph.

subcommands.name: batch-get-graph-member-datasources
subcommands.description: Gets data source package information for the behavior graph.

subcommands.name: batch-get-membership-datasources
subcommands.description: Gets information on the data source package history for an account.

subcommands.name: create-graph
subcommands.description: Creates a new behavior graph for the calling account, and sets that account as the administrator account.

subcommands.name: create-members
subcommands.description: CreateMembers is used to send invitations to accounts.

subcommands.name: delete-graph
subcommands.description: Disables the specified behavior graph and queues it to be deleted.

subcommands.name: delete-members
subcommands.description: Removes the specified member accounts from the behavior graph.

subcommands.name: describe-organization-configuration
subcommands.description: Returns information about the configuration for the organization behavior graph.

subcommands.name: disable-organization-admin-account
subcommands.description: Removes the Detective administrator account in the current Region.

subcommands.name: disassociate-membership
subcommands.description: Removes the member account from the specified behavior graph.

subcommands.name: enable-organization-admin-account
subcommands.description: Designates the Detective administrator account for the organization in the current Region.

subcommands.name: get-investigation
subcommands.description: Detective investigations lets you investigate IAM users and IAM roles using indicators of compromise.

subcommands.name: get-members
subcommands.description: Returns the membership details for specified member accounts for a behavior graph.

subcommands.name: list-datasource-packages
subcommands.description: Lists data source packages in the behavior graph.

subcommands.name: list-graphs
subcommands.description: Returns the list of behavior graphs that the calling account is an administrator account of.

subcommands.name: list-indicators
subcommands.description: Gets the indicators from an investigation.

subcommands.name: list-investigations
subcommands.description: Detective investigations lets you investigate IAM users and IAM roles using indicators of compromise.

subcommands.name: list-invitations
subcommands.description: Retrieves the list of open and accepted behavior graph invitations for the member account.

subcommands.name: list-members
subcommands.description: Retrieves the list of member accounts for a behavior graph.

subcommands.name: list-organization-admin-accounts
subcommands.description: Returns information about the Detective administrator account for an organization.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Returns the tag values that are assigned to a behavior graph.

subcommands.name: reject-invitation
subcommands.description: Rejects an invitation to contribute the account data to a behavior graph.

subcommands.name: start-investigation
subcommands.description: Detective investigations lets you investigate IAM users and IAM roles using indicators of compromise.

subcommands.name: start-monitoring-member
subcommands.description: Sends a request to enable data ingest for a member account that has a status of ACCEPTED_BUT_DISABLED.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Applies tag values to a behavior graph.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes tags from a behavior graph.

subcommands.name: update-datasource-packages
subcommands.description: Starts a data source package for the Detective behavior graph.

subcommands.name: update-investigation-state
subcommands.description: Updates the state of an investigation.

subcommands.name: update-organization-configuration
subcommands.description: Updates the configuration for the Organizations integration in the current Region.
